expectations.text: Shows evidence of reading the existing Orders and Notifications contexts
expectations.evidence: Quotes Order Shipped and the core/generic tags.

expectations.text: Identifies it as a single one-directional relationship to record (Orders as the source/upstream, Notifications as the consumer/downstream) rather than vaguely 'connected'
Conveys the team-autonomy implication of the recommended shape (e.g. a translation layer lets the core Orders context change without breaking Notifications)
expectations.evidence: 'you don't want your core Orders context bending to accommodate a generic notifications concern.'

expectations.text: Keeps user-facing language plain — does not dump raw DDD label names, invent non-canonical labels, or propose several patterns at once
expectations.evidence: Dumps TWO raw labels at once — 'Customer/Supplier combined with Published Language' — plus an invented type/integration field schema.

expectations.text: Uses the Q:/Recommendation format with a concrete recommendation about which integration shape to use
